notes.title: Update 01/24/2025
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/015f14ef9a217240502b7d1559f726d159583006.jpg[/img]

1. New functionality has been added to the last three levels of the "Arena" building.
- Level 8 of the building - the card gets +2 levels.
- Level 9 of the building - the card gets +3 levels.
- Level 10 of the building - the card gets +4 levels.
2. Sound effects have been added for the abilities of the cards: Frosty Hoarfrosts, Frosty Golem, Smoldering Zombie, Scorching Slime, Dead Bride, House Spirit.
3. Animations have been added to the images of the cards: Fire Ants, Smoldering Zombie, Frosty Golem, Frosty Hoarfrosts.
4. The ability to upgrade the "Summoning Portal" building during its active phase has been added.
- It is possible to simultaneously summon cards and upgrade the "Summoning Portal" building itself.
5. The image and animation of the "Spiked Trap" building have been updated.
6. The description in the "Crystal Tree" window has been updated.
7. The results of the clan battle are displayed at the end of the battles taking into account the balanced players.
8. An error in displaying avatars: Sylvia, Lutka has been corrected.
9. An error in displaying the level of the upgraded building in the pop-up notification has been corrected.
10. An error in the visual display of received messages in the chat has been corrected.
11. Various localization errors have been corrected.

notes.title: Update 12/17/2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/015f14ef9a217240502b7d1559f726d159583006.jpg[/img]

[b]1. In the "Shop: Buildings" window, you can now switch between the Buy/Upgrade/Skins tabs.
2. The mechanics of obtaining cards: Fang Fairy, Sprightly Sprout have been changed.
- To unlock the ability to obtain these cards from the Summon Portal, players need to complete the "Upcoming Concerns" quest.
3. The image of the "Obelisk of Elements" building has been updated.
- The image changes depending on the chosen elemental stones in the structure.
4. Added animations to the card images: Scorching Slime, Dryad, Knight on a Gryphon.
5. Updated the ability animation for the "Standard Bearer" card.
6. Fixed an error in the ability of the "Fire Shaman" card.
- The "Freezing Fire" ability takes away 25% of the opponents' health each turn when activated.
7. Fixed an error in displaying the winners of each stage in the "Stone Pillars" game mode.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/25404f918c6f36502fd681fb0d5b04870a438467.jpg[/img]

1. A new game mode "City Development" has been added.
- A new game mode is available in the event center.
2. Added the ability to form and save additional decks:
- Deck of cards, Clan battles, Blitz Tournament.
3. Added animation of the usual and improved image to the maps:
- The child of Lamia, the Treacherous vagabond, the Warriors of the north.
4. The image of the Slot Cutter building has been updated. Animation has been added to the building.
5. Added a sound effect when creating magic in the Spell Realm.
6. Information help has been added to the image change window for buildings of the same type.
7. Fixed an error in the interaction of the abilities of the "Bilviz" and "Ice Dragon" cards.
-Bilviz is reborn from his ability if he dies under the influence of the Ice Dragon's ability.
8. Fixed a bug in the interaction of the abilities of the "Water Elemental" and "Sparkling Needletail" cards.
-The ability of the Water Elemental is always triggered by the ability of the Sparkling Needletail card, provided that the Water Elemental has not yet entered the battle.
9. Fixed an error in displaying animations of images for maps in the map information window.
10. Various localization errors have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 02/16/2024
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e1c1d48ef348d7ec4e29ba3f35818e9a4b972d94.jpg[/img]

1. A unique reward has been added to clan battles, which can be obtained by defeating your opponents in KB for 5 stars.
- As a reward, players will be able to receive pieces from the “Collector of Knowledge" card.
2. A new rivalry format “Seasons” has been added to the “Blitz Tournament” game mode.
- Once a month, the strongest players of the blitz tournament will be determined, whose rating will be displayed in the ”Seasons" tab.
- The duration of one season is 30 days.
- The best of the best will receive rewards at the end of the season: Coins of Valor, a Champion's Chest. The number of awards depends on the ranking position.
3. The PVP rating “TOP 100” has become a full-fledged event!
- The TOP 100 ranking is now updated every month.
- The winner of the rating will receive a special avatar for the "Strongest” profile as a reward.
4. Pieces from the Desert Nomad card have been added to the tournament chests for 1st and 2nd place in the fifth league.
5. New profile avatars have been added.
6. The sound of the ability of the Lava Golem card has been updated.
7. The sound of the animation of increasing the level and rank of the map has been updated.
8. Added animation of the usual and improved image to the maps: Desert nomad, Zhu Baze, Xing Xing, Voracious young.
9. The images of the cards have been updated: Chimera, Dark Guardsman, Brisk Sprout, Poisonous Anaconda, Fanged Fairy.
10. Updated images of buildings: Crystal Tree, Tomb of Titan, Slot Carver.
- Crystal trees and the Tomb of Titan are animated.
11. New rules and penalties have been introduced for players to switch from clan to clan. When switching from one clan to another, players will be fined a time limit on joining a new clan.
- Leaving the clan in League 1 is penalized for 24 hours.
- Leaving the clan in the 2-3 league is fined for 48 hours.
- Leaving the clan in the 4-5 league is fined for 72 hours.
- Leaving the clan in League 6 is not available until the end of the annual clan tournament.
12. Fixed a bug in the interaction of the abilities of the “Lamia” and “Ice Dragon" cards.
- Lamia's ability works according to the description.
13. Various localization errors have been fixed.

notes.title: Clash of champions
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/52fca738fddcca7843b4e140038b870296657a45.jpg[/img]

[h3]New game mode “Clash of Champions”.[/h3]

Adventurers are already waiting for a new game event, Contest of Champions!

You can get acquainted with the new event in the Blitz tournament window, in the Skirmish tab.

[b]A new game event is available from level 15. Participation price is 1 candidate ticket. This game event is available every 24 hours. Event duration is 1 hour.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e0c247c868a45941030ffcb794f00f1e3daa5c22.jpg[/img]

When you click on the “Participate” button, adventurers find themselves in a room that has already been created previously by other players, or create their own, to which other players join.

[b]There can be no more than 5 battle mages in the room at the same time![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/4e37e3b7a214ebb4c1b5e8f501bdbc943f4b7407.jpg[/img]

When you click on the Participate button, the countdown begins from 1 hour, during which the player must fight and accumulate points.

Battle points are called Proof of Valor - they must be earned in other game modes: Mage Tournaments, Raids, Clan Battles, Catacombs, PVP battles, PVP revenge, Blitz Tournament, PVE quests, Island conquests.

Points are obtained according to the following principle: 1 unit. for each surviving card in battle + 2 units. for victory. Thus, for a complete victory at 5/0, the player will receive 7 points (5 for surviving cards and 2 for winning). If the adventurer loses and only 2 cards survive, then there will be 2 units. points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/256d5a7e3497c3723115d90d17a06010d97f645c.jpg[/img]

[b]Important: The player can start accumulating points immediately, even if he is alone in the newly created room. Its time begins to tick immediately from the moment the room is created. If a new player joins a room 5 minutes after it was started (created) by the first player, the second player's event time will be reduced to 55 minutes. The time of the room with the event is calculated according to the first player.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e0c247c868a45941030ffcb794f00f1e3daa5c22.jpg[/img]

The personal points that a battle mage earns reflect his place in the top. The player who scores more points than the rest will win. Only one participant in the event who takes first place in the personal ranking receives the award.

Also, there is a total number of points for all players, which are summed up and affect progression along the reward scale. The more points players score in total, the more rewards the event winner can take home.

[b]Level 1 - 50 points

Level 2 - 100 points

Level 3 - 150 points

Level 4 - 200 points

Level 5 - 300 points

Level 6 - 400 points

Level 7 - 550 points

Level 8 - 700 points

Level 9 - 850 points

Level 10 - 1000 points[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/6ec2f42b67787f989bf13aa6486f9a910b6ea915.jpg[/img]

At the end of the allotted time, the treasured “Collect reward” button will be displayed for the adventurer who took first place.

Battle mages who are unlucky enough to defeat their opponents can take part in the event again after 30 minutes. The winner of the Fight, according to the rules, has the opportunity to try his hand at this event again only after 24 hours.


Pieces from the new card “Bloodthirsty Merry Man” have been added to the game event as the main reward.

notes.title: Update 10.18.2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/25404f918c6f36502fd681fb0d5b04870a438467.jpg[/img]

1. A new game mode “Clash of Champions” has been added.
- Game mode is available in the Blitz Tournament window, in the “Fight” tab.
2. The cards adaptation of cards and the functioning of bonuses in Blitz Tournament have been changed.
3. The number of chest rewards granted for clan wars now increases with the clan’s League.
4. Triggering of certain cards’ abilities is now limited.
5. The new “Battle Pass” promo has been added.
6. Players now have the ability to write direct messages to other players.
7. The new “Autoplay” system has been added to the Blitz Tournament game mode.
8. Regular and advanced skins of the following cards are now animated:
- Gargoyle Guard, Slayer Scorpion, Steam Golem, Blood Fortune-teller.
9. The appearance of the following buildings has been updated: Fountain, Observatory, Citadel.
10. A notification is now displayed on the Event Center icon when the tasks of the Supplies game mode get completed and when new activities appear in the event center.
11. The shield prices have been changed:
- The price of a two-day shield has increased from 150 to 200 crystals.
- The price of a one-week shield has increased from 375 to 550 crystals.
12. We have fixed the error that prevented players from getting rewards for completing the tasks in the Supplies game mode.
13. We have fixed the game freezing error in the following quests: “Epsilon the Robot” and “It’s not a bug, it’s a feature”.
14. We have fixed the error of long waiting mode after purchasing the premium pass in the Great Trial game mode.
15. We have fixed the error of displaying special icons over crystal trees during their activity and over the citadel during tournaments..
16. We have fixed the error of incorrect display of the Scavenger Harpy animation on the Swamp Harpy card.
17. We have fixed the error of incorrect display of account synchronization icon when the account is already synced.
18. We have fixed the error of incorrect display of clan members’ names in the “Clan members without titles” window.
19. We have fixed the incorrect display error of partly completed premium skins of the following cards: 1) Earth Titan 2) Sun Titan 3) Yag Sarog 4) Dagoth'Sha.
20. We have fixed the error of incorrect display of the Tournament for Resources in the Event Center.
21. We have fixed the error of incorrect display of the Dream Eater card skin in the “Destruction of Domes” quest.
22. The text error in the “Strong but clever” quest has been fixed.
23. Various localization errors have been fixed.

notes.title: Update 08.30.2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/25404f918c6f36502fd681fb0d5b04870a438467.jpg[/img]

[b]1. We have added the ‘Events Center’ with all the current adventures, ongoing promotions and discounts. All promotion windows have been updated.[/b]
- The Events Center icon is in the top right corner of your castle, below the indicators of gold and mana.
[b]2. A new questline has been added to the ‘Ancient Gods’ campaign. Players will get pieces of the new Epsilon card for completing the quests.[/b]
- For completing all the quests, players get 25 pieces of the Epsilon card that allow them to create a card of Uncommon rarity. Other pieces of the card will be added to other game modes during future updates.
[b]3. The game now includes an additional tutorial for new players that helps them get started with the following game modes: Raids, Catacombs, Island Conquests, Clan Castle, Crystal Tree, Card limit.[/b]
[b]4. Additional information about the player’s title in the clan is now displayed in the clan window, below the clan’s name.[/b]
[b]6. The chest for completing daily clan tasks has been moved to the Shop, to the Chests section.[/b]
[b]7. The appearance of the following buildings has been updated:[/b] Elemental Stones market, Catacombs, Summoning Portal, Gold mines, Mana wells, Servants’ cottages. The animation of the updated buildings has been changed. The buildings look the same on all levels.
[b]8. The ability of the Jungle Raiders card has been improved.[/b]
- The percentage of the ability boost for amulets has increased from 10% to 15%. The number of allied cards, which get the bonus from this ability, has increased from 2 to 3.
[b]9. The ability of Abbigail the Doll card has been changed.[/b]
- The trigger chance of the Best Friend ability has decreased. The ability affects 2-3 enemy cards.
[b]10. We have updated the skins of the Scavenger Harpy and the Steam Golem cards.
11. The ability error of the Many-faced Demon card has been fixed.[/b]
- The ability now functions according to the description.
[b]12. The interaction error of the Earth Elemental and the Bone Dragon cards in the Blitz Tournament game mode has been fixed.[/b]
- The ability of the Bone Dragon now works according to the description.
[b]13. The ability error of the Kissin Crayfish card has been fixed.[/b]
- The Magic Mirror ability now functions according to the description.
[b]14. The ability error of the Royal Hounds card has been fixed.[/b]
- The ability now functions according to the description.
[b]15. The animation error of the Fierce Bloodfang card has been fixed.
16. The error of the info box with the battle ability description has been fixed. Now it is displayed correctly when the player clicks on an enemy card.
17. The error of the Slot Carver building (no ‘Select’ button) has been fixed.
18. The error of incorrect display of players’ names in the clan requests window has been fixed.
19. We have fixed the errors of incorrect display of daily clan tasks’ progress during the completion of such tasks.[/b]
[b]20. We have fixed the error when it’s impossible to upgrade Banners even with all conditions met.
21. The error of incorrect display of Top 100 clans has been fixed.
22. We have fixed the error of incorrect display of amulets info when they are being inserted into a card.[/b]
[b]23. Various localization mistakes have been fixed.[/b]

notes.title: Update 05.17.2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/74d272418e1444cbb5a1334cde08dbd75fbf14a9.jpg[/img]

1. We have added new cards:
- Atagul, Fire Elemental, Air Elemental, Dark Elemental, Water Elemental, Concentration of Elements, Royal Hounds.
2. A new game event "Supplies" has been added.
- Players need to supply and develop their castle using specific resources. As a reward, they receive pieces of the new card — Dark Elemental.
3. A new Mysterious Island has been added.
- For defeating quest enemies on the Mysterious Island, players get rewards: resources and pieces of the new card — Concentration of Elements.
4. The Fountain of Luck now produces pieces of the new card Atagul once every 24 hours.
5. The Light Elemental card has been renamed and now is a new card — Spark of Light.
6. Three new top charts (Top 3, Top 7, and Top 13) have been added to the Tournament of Mages, therefore we have revised the amount of resources given as rewards for other positions.
7. The cost of resource exchange has been reduced on 6-10 levels of Elemental Stone Market and Magic Transmogrifier.
8. We have updated the skin for the Blademaster Naga card and added a premium skin.
9. In the Tournament for Resources, the reward "Titan’s Blood x5" has been changed to "Random Spell x2" for players ranking 901-1000.
10. The "Go" button in daily tasks is now always active and takes you to the stage that is required for completion.
11. The description of the Primal Turtle card’s ability has been added to the English version of the game.
12. We have fixed the game freeze error that occurred at the launch of the VIP quest "Road to the Sanctuary".
13. We have fixed the error of score distribution among players in the Blitz Tournament.
14. We have fixed the debuff icon display error of the Earth Elemental card's ability.
15. The error causing the incorrect work of the Inuho card has been fixed.
- Inuho gets bonuses to its stats when fighting against a Black element card.
16. Various localization errors have been corrected.

- The maximum level of cards has been increased to level 80.
- Amulets level increased to 16.
- Added 2 additional levels to defensive and offensive structures.

- Added 2 additional levels to Elemental Crystals.

- Epic

- Spend elemental essence.
[h3]5. Added background backgrounds to windows:[/h3]
- Daily quest for elemental stones
- Daily quest for soul shards
- Daily quest for amulets and resources
- Card deck
- Backgrounds have been added for a number of quest campaigns, such as: Lion Hunt, Temple of the Forgotten Gods, Forest Band."
[h3]6. Added animations for the characters: Plague Rodent, Spooky Scarecrow, Scolopendra.[/h3]

[h3]9. Updated map images:[/h3]
- Minotaur, Novice girl, Sorceress.
[h3]10. Fixed a bug with counting the number of battles in the Catacombs game mode.[/h3]

notes.title: Blitz Tournament
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a8b87d25a3dc9c7e92e18173a80968123f4a9bb4.jpg[/img]

Blitz Tournament is a new game mode, in which players can fight each other in real time and earn valuable resources.
Blitz Tournament is an experimental mode. Please report all bugs to the game administrators.
The Blitz Tournament icon is located on the right bottom panel, near the Battle Pass icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/47346d9507319d070d5dfc12bb466241930daaaa.jpg[/img]

Click the icon to open a window and choose the type of participation:

[b]For gold[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/dbc4b499af79440eb3861b8c490170a0da52d1e9.jpg[/img]

[b]For Tickets[/b]

You need Challenger’s Tickets to take part in Blitz Tournaments. Players can buy them in the Blitz Tournament mode by clicking the “+” icon to the right of the ticket counter or by purchasing a special set for crystals. Besides, you can earn Challenger’s Tickets in a Blitz Tournament as well.
Depending on the type of participation, the rewards for prize-winning places will differ. It is more profitable to join Blitz Tournaments using Challenger’s Tickets, because you can get much more rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/9f47553624c3d5c868e7ee4aeabf00286c165b2c.jpg[/img]

For a Blitz Tournament to take place, you need 6 players in one room. Each player builds a deck to use in the Blitz Tournament and waits for other players to join the room. Matchmaking is based on the strength of tournament decks. Once the deck for the Blitz Tournament is built, the selected cards can’t be used in other game modes or strengthened with amulets. You also can’t improve their level or rank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/f050fd39d3b4cfcebc61b5ac2f8e047cc32663e3.jpg[/img]

The new game mode restricts the use of cards of a certain color or type. These restrictions change every 24 hours. Blitz Tournaments allow bonuses from elemental crystals, but you can’t use defense or attack buildings. Element days and creature days are not supported in this mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/1f6f6480c9926511756bbee7479d1ddd140fdea3.jpg[/img]

The waiting time limit is 5 minutes. If there aren’t enough players after 5 minutes, the participants get back the resources  they have spent to join a Blitz Tournament.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e0016210c9adef843ffc396ce4796ffa2e11d0eb.jpg[/img]

The battle mode in a Blitz Tournament is slightly different from other battle modes.

The player chooses a card to attack, and at this moment the attacking card is opened for the opponent to assess the situation, choose a defense card, and use spells. Each player has 25 seconds to make the decision.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e94e8b63668054cb43822c6b493b31988e962ea1.jpg[/img]

Every Blitz Tournament consists of 5 stages. Each stage lasts for a limited period of time. One stage means a battle with one opponent. During 5 stages, every player will have 5 battles with other players.

[b]Please note:[/b]

If anyone leaves the game mode before a Blitz Tournament is over, such a player will automatically lose. If they leave the game mode by mistake or for any other reason, they have time to return to the Blitz Tournament, but only if it isn’t over yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/30d49f3cd848c272929d4657d1c00e860a358449.jpg[/img]

When all 5 stages are over, the players see the winners’ rating and the reward that corresponds to their places.


Coins of valor are special points that can be scored in the Blitz Tournament game mode. They can be used to open chests with special rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/2184e77f89d2f26e948fad70dec8f3e2ec844ab0.jpg[/img]

[b]Rewards[/b]

In the Blitz Tournament game mode there are 5 chests:

Constancy Chest = 500 coins of valor

The most affordable chest that contains standard resources.

Strong Chest = 1000 coins of valor

Chest of Life = 1000 coins of valor

These chests contain rare cards: Amazon, Sea Cavalry, White Lion, Miracle Sphinx, Phoenix, Blade Maiden, Insectum, Bogey.

Chest of the Era = 5000 coins of valor

Shiny Chest = 5000 coins of valor

These chests contain epic cards: Grimlock Mechatorque, Yarven the Spellthief, Hilda the Crystalist, Torgrim the Bonebreaker, Unfric the Digger, Avaris the Warrior, Vytianka.

notes.title: Killer Bunny
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/33bd1102164c64e23e14bef48cf75d1013a6b037.jpg[/img]

[h3]Killer Bunny[/h3]

Spring brings not only warm weather, but also a new quest adventure with a unique creature — Killer Bunny! What is it? Why has it come to the realm right now? You will find out when you complete the Spring Holiday quest, and in this article we will review the key characteristics of this creature.

[h3]Killer Bunny[/h3]

One, two, three, four, five,
No one will be left alive!
If it's Titan passing by,
Bunny aims at Titan's eye.
Whoosh! Bang! Badaboom!
Killer bunny is Titan's Doom…

[h3]— Skins[/h3]

• Regular skin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c798998f77c35fada17905ad655e338c80c7c918.jpg[/img]

• Advanced skin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/5589d71c96d857b075031dd4e2c24a8695d5e5e5.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Battle[/h3]

The new Killer Bunny card has the Sack of Gifts ability. When attacking, the card has a chance of dealing damage increased by 1000% to any creature that belongs to the “Titan” type.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]

Thanks to its ability, Killer Bunny can become a true nightmare of Titans and gods. They are the only creatures that are vulnerable to its ability. No one can survive the damage increased by 1000%, so Killer Bunny’s ability trigger chance determines the outcome of a battle against any Titan.

When upgraded to the maximum, Killer Bunny has an excellent amount of health and deals decent damage on a par with many powerful cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/635aa811db4006fcff2bdc86564aaa5ed7a7ec1d.jpg[/img]

[h3]Battle interaction with other cards:[/h3]

If the opponent isn’t a Titan, Killer Bunny fights best with a Leader among its allies — for example, a Werewolf, who allows Killer Bunny attack first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/12dbcd29de63505f3b6f7d4756317f8d3b0d8483.jpg[/img]

The Forged Sentinel Leader card gives additional armor to its allies. Thanks to this simple tanking, Killer Bunny can stand up against many cards. Other Leaders are also worth considering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c39c4d471b56fd31514200586a102923bdc9ebf6.jpg[/img]

In battle, Killer Bunny should watch out for cards that can prevent it from using magic. For example, Krampus can cast muteness for two turns. A mute Killer Bunny has no advantage over Titans.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e32779e1b91b49d6cf83db36baf2379766bef14c.jpg[/img]

Caladrius will be a great ally for Killer Bunny. His ability allows to remove all negative effects from allied cards.


[h3]— Amulets[/h3]

Though Killer Bunny is Titan’s Doom indeed, don’t forget that this card may have to fight other types of creatures in battle. Killer Bunny needs upgrades that increase its ability trigger chance and health, so that it could “outtank” its opponents. We recommend the following amulets:

[b]Amulet of Vigilance[/b]

Considerably increases Killer Bunny’s health and thus helps the card endure enemy attacks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ef51fec4f6ad15cbea423ef438519ebf2c5d9be2.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Defense[/b]

Increases health and slightly reduces damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/99bff96d5de63697e2dc740219b154536e2940af.png[/img]

[b]Green Amulet of Life[/b]

Increases the card’s ability trigger chance and health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/6612dcec01e0c7d33bb98bda208751e7ea29d7fd.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Rage[/b]

Significantly increases damage dealt by Killer Bunny, helping the card reach the level of the strongest creatures, but reduces health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/724f58817257aed4fda0e923f320cd747eb76beb.png[/img]

[h3]— Цвет карты[/h3]

[h3]— Card color[/h3]

[b]Green[/b]

The Green color provides an advantage over Red cards. But you will need to make an effort to defeat Black and Colorless opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e3ccd2c75ac61a4f00e2d957601b6b983b202d0e.png[/img]

[h3]— Spells[/h3]

[b]Luck[/b]

With this spell, Killer Bunny’s ability trigger chance against Titans will reach a near-maximum level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/bd0e20d632a01e5fb364e86243bb19451dd2f30d.png[/img]

[b]Talisman[/b]

Increases the card’s health, so that Killer Bunny can endure enemy attacks when played in defense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0ac1e8e76826bfa4163db4db46fe09c22e70c185.png[/img]

Killer Bunny rightfully deserves the title of Titan’s Doom. Thanks to its ability, it will most likely defeat all creatures that belong to the “Titan” type. Its attack is on a par with other strongest cards, and when its health is increased by amulets and a spell, Killer Bunny can compete with creatures of other types on an equal footing.

notes.title: Clutch Guardian
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/d9c52621b3f7a98ac1e1f288dabfb63fc56c3744.jpg[/img]

[h3]Clutch Guardian[/h3]

The main prize of the Great Trial of April is the epic card Clutch Guardian. Read this article to learn where this giant lizard can be found and what to expect if you meet it on the battlefield.

[h3]Clutch Guardian [/h3]

These gigantic lizards dwell in caves beneath rainforest canopy. Despite their impressive size, they are harmless creatures who prefer to feed on fruit and various plants. However, things are different when a giant reptile is guarding her clutch of eggs. She will immediately attack any intruder who dares to disturb the nest.

[h3]— Skins[/h3]

• Regular skin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b921e8014ae9f4904c3910908e8d86e75fbf599d.jpg[/img]

• Advanced skin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/379f4610d4ce7cc48cd8669d5e3d5a537eb885be.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Battle[/h3]

Clutch Guardian has the Motherly Love ability: she assumes that allied cards are her hatchlings. Each dead hatchling adds % to her attack, and each victorious hatchling adds % to her health.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]

Clutch Guardian’s physical characteristics aren’t the best ones, but she can even the odds with any opponent by increasing her attack and health. This card is usually played at the end of the battle, so that it could fight with maximum stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/7d7c55e29c21962ba4eb805ec5e598d883f8bc0e.jpg[/img]

[h3]Battle interaction with other cards:[/h3]

Clutch Guardian increases its stats in any case — with every victory or defeat of her allies. To reach maximum battle performance, she needs the support of Sun Titan who can boost her stats even more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/abc2741e2a9f550954ae92e37bcaa2e523b011b9.jpg[/img]

Leader cards can grant Clutch Guardian an extra advantage using their strengthening abilities. Kraken will be the best option because it increases its allies’ ability percentage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/621f67f0aca4e3aa27723ed8a24033d5e9090d53.jpg[/img]

Valkyries will provide good assistance in battle. They can use their Warrior’s Duty ability to resurrect Clutch Guardian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/74645fddb33b76050561b27e1e9b2731d88e2e57.jpg[/img]

In battle, Clutch Guardian should watch out for cards that can prevent her from using her ability: Mimic, Krampus, Archivist.
Oneshoter cards are also dangerous opponents for Clutch Guardian, because they can score a quick victory due to their abilities: Carnivorous Toad, Red Dragon, etc. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/8c64e02b0075855fad2a706fbfb8ac69158f1ab5.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Amulets[/h3]

[b]White Amulet of Defense[/b]

Increases the card’s health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b79ec888aedb99880b2d6ef48e99b3829b0af080.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Vigilance[/b]

Considerably increases health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ef51fec4f6ad15cbea423ef438519ebf2c5d9be2.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Attack[/b]

Slightly increases attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ab5385336180fae49204af6cedfcc71adab2c833.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Luck[/b]

Increases the card’s ability trigger chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a9cf0e99989c629594887ac789bd8523113227af.png[/img]

[h3]— Card colour[/h3]

[b]White[/b]

Provides an advantage over cards of the Black element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/dd95dcedf83396ef180723b11af2506a55cc3d6c.png[/img]

[h3]— Spells[/h3]

[b]Maximum Damage[/b]

Increases the minimum attack of the card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0764c43db47d6d3ceff7d4c3b539964db32d19e3.png[/img]

[b]Divine Gift[/b]

Removes the Mutness effect and allows the card to use its ability again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/4004867cc64935020f0a6c7a76918cc98220dc07.png[/img]

[b]Luck[/b]

A very important spell that will significantly enhance the boost of stats provided by the Motherly Love ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/bd0e20d632a01e5fb364e86243bb19451dd2f30d.png[/img]

You can obtain Clutch Guardian in the Great Trial game mode that will be available until the end of April.

notes.title: Voracious Hatchlings
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e752bcb808b6b7ed6307c778747735e4a2162abb.jpg[/img]

[h3]Voracious Hatchlings[/h3]

The hatchlings of giant lizards are always hungry. Unlike their parents, they don't mind feasting on small animals and even bigger creatures, but only when they have the upper hand. In case of danger, little lizards instantly take shelter to escape enemy attacks and wait for the right time to strike back.

[h3]— Skins[/h3]

• Regular skin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/78895359e6f9a5e4aaec88349665e0bcf352956c.jpg[/img]

• Advanced skin

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/6d62f0d244020135accf38a7b30827871b7f180e.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Battle[/h3]

Voracious Hatchlings have the Protective Eggshell ability. At the beginning of a duel, they hide inside an eggshell, so the damage from the first two direct attacks of an enemy will be reduced by % (the card’s ability value). Titans are immune.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]

The Voracious Hatchlings card has an impressive amount of health, and its ability can block some damage from the first two attacks of its opponent.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/55424d3aa2a6df980573884dee74b8f0ce729207.jpg[/img]

[h3]Battle interaction with other cards:[/h3]

Sun Titan will help Voracious Hatchlings increase their attack and health. Such an ally boosts the card’s stats in the best possible way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/8af4cdb4176bf0846e72d1fbd58d08a4d05c4ded.jpg[/img]

The leader card Werewolf can significantly improve Voracious Hatchlings’s chances of winning. The Leader: Terrible Howl ability will make an opponent skip a turn. As a result, Voracious Hatchlings will have a great advantage over an enemy and a chance to win while keeping more than half of their health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/30c57e4fe4e344e30832e4e7250fa63b42c27bd1.jpg[/img]

In battle, watch out for cards that can prevent Voracious Hatchlings from using their ability, such as Mimic or Archivist.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ce5c526c67c90e5eba6518d2c699f80c4e5f994a.jpg[/img]

Players should also bear in mind that Titans are immune to the Protective Eggshell ability, so it would be very hard for Voracious Hatchlings to defeat the legendary opponent in a single combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/07ba7fcbb6e5297af88d9465c4172356a9249893.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Amulets[/h3]

[b]White Amulet of Defense[/b]

Increases the card’s health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b79ec888aedb99880b2d6ef48e99b3829b0af080.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Vigilance[/b]

Considerably increases health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ef51fec4f6ad15cbea423ef438519ebf2c5d9be2.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Attack[/b]

Slightly increases attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ab5385336180fae49204af6cedfcc71adab2c833.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Luck[/b]

Increases the card’s ability trigger chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a9cf0e99989c629594887ac789bd8523113227af.png[/img]

[h3]— Card colour[/h3]

[b]White[/b]

Provides an advantage over cards of the Black element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/dd95dcedf83396ef180723b11af2506a55cc3d6c.png[/img]

[h3]— Spells[/h3]

[b]Maximum Damage[/b]

Increases the card’s minimum attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0764c43db47d6d3ceff7d4c3b539964db32d19e3.png[/img]

[b]Berserk[/b]

Increases attack and slightly reduces health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/804c50458eb061db5059578c5995428f1d8def12.png[/img]

[b]Talisman[/b]

Increases the card’s health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0ac1e8e76826bfa4163db4db46fe09c22e70c185.png[/img]

Voracious Hatchlings have powerful battle instincts that have ensured the survival of the whole species for centuries. This card will considerably increase the battle potential of your deck.

You can obtain the promo card Voracious Hatchlings in the Great Trial game mode. Good luck on the battlefield!

notes.title: Warg Pups
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/2fc94838aafa220e1fdc176742174ede1b517fa6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Warg Pups[/h3]

In the recent tournament, mages fought for the epic card Warg Pups. In this article, we are going to give a detailed review of this card and its characteristics.

[h3]Warg Pups[/h3]

Wargs look like wolves, but they are much larger and more dangerous even as pups. But the main difference is that wargs are sentient beings. The ability to think makes them deadly predators indeed.

[h3]— Skins[/h3]

• Regular

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ec9816c1bead6d7e3e420f99e2a412bd002b2b08.jpg[/img]

• Advanced

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/887b83c2b2342b54fb63c82779d95017f8b3bde7.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Battle[/h3]

Warg Pups have the Trapped ability — during each attack, the card reduces an opponent’s ability trigger chance by a certain percentage (even down to 0), and increases its own attack proportionally.

[h3]Advantages:[/h3]

Warg Pups have a decent amount of health, and their ability allows them to increase attack by reducing an opponent’s ability trigger chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/695dfe40b7ce9c6afc2fd18999db2bd182eaa118.jpg[/img]

[h3]Battle interaction with other cards:[/h3]

Leader cards, such as Werewolf and Griffin Rider can become good allies. They will increase the survivability of Warg Pups and allow them to attack more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c0ee72521c82eb49b6dce8e7624bdeaf81aa3c48.jpg[/img]

In battle Warg Pups should beware cards that can prevent them from using magic: Mimic and Krampus.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ae58a8844470d3be5d451900de4b300bbb7e076e.jpg[/img]

Besides, fighting any Titan will be fatal for Warg Pups, because Titans are immune to the Trapped ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/754f9f604416a2bae00cd0a8c52ead4f787192bf.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Amulets[/h3]

[b]King's Amulet[/b]

Increases attack, health, and ability trigger chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b0931c4af978de5287c1858e771a76b825e645be.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Vigilance[/b]

Considerably increases the card's health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ef51fec4f6ad15cbea423ef438519ebf2c5d9be2.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Attack[/b]

Increases attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ab5385336180fae49204af6cedfcc71adab2c833.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Health[/b]

Increases the card’s amount of health.

[h3]— Card colour[/h3]

[b]Colorless[/b]

The card’s opponents won’t have any advantages over it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/9936df6452bff09ce44fa4494ad9de0c41b20699.png[/img]

[h3]— Spells[/h3]

[b]Luck[/b]

Increases the ability trigger chance of Warg Pups.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/bd0e20d632a01e5fb364e86243bb19451dd2f30d.png[/img]

[b]Berserk[/b]

Increases attack but slightly reduces health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/804c50458eb061db5059578c5995428f1d8def12.png[/img]

[b]Talisman[/b]

Increases health and improves the chances to win when in defence.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0ac1e8e76826bfa4163db4db46fe09c22e70c185.png[/img]

Warg pups, as any colorless card, are quite self-sufficient. In battle, Warg pups always rely on their instincts that never let them down.

[h3]1. A referral system is launched to attract new players.[/h3]

We have added a new referral system to attract new players to the game. By inviting your friends to the world of Blood of Titans, you earn valuable rewards and build a tight-knit game community.
The new feature is available on the top right tab of the player profile: Invite a friend.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c0e02e5e75d89962d4a4b5e51ca3cd8856e3da7b.jpg[/img]

In the new window, you will see the progress bar divided into sections 1/5/10/15. Each section displays the number of invited players and corresponds to a certain reward.

1 invitation = 10 random skin fragments
5 invitations = 150 crystals
10 invitations = An avatar for your player profile
15 invitations = A special card

Apart from these rewards, you will get special keys for each invited player. Use them to open the referral chest with rewards. You receive 100 keys for 1 invited player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/f36c96514e3f259dbcfa8a4e2a675d12ad9b1ea6.jpg[/img]

[b]PLEASE NOTE![/b]

Your invitation will be counted only if an invited player enters your referral code right after finishing the tutorial.

If an invited player doesn’t enter your referral code right after finishing the tutorial, your invitation won’t be counted when this player reaches Level 15.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/d6573ff2353794c37c8a2c07d557ebca4d59998d.jpg[/img]

As soon as an invited player reaches Level 15, it will be counted in the reward progress bar. After entering a referral code, an invited player gets a random Uncommon card.

After inviting 15 friends who fulfill all the requirements of the referral program, you will get the main reward: the Moon Spirit promo card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b00725f11edab06e56f6624d42ef100ada920b5b.jpg[/img]

Players can invite more than 15 friends, but the reward will include only 100 referral chest keys per invitation.

The referral code is assigned permanently to every player and can’t be changed. Besides, the referral code is linked to a certain game platform and can’t be used to invite players on other game platforms

notes.title: Leprechaun
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/51dab9d287b819bfd1efa9cd30299f57616ae75a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Leprechaun[/h3]

March will bring a unique Leprechaun promo card to the lucky ones. A being so famous that legends about its untold wealth reached the extremity of the Kingdom.

[h3]Leprechaun[/h3]

Legends say that those who catch a leprechaun can demand gold or a wish in exchange for his freedom.The cunning leprechaun will dutifully agree to any demand, however, he will always be able to dodge and do much harm to an invader.

[h3]— Images[/h3]

• Usual

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/114f2c1b1e69a078e42023bf1258bf571aa5d796.jpg[/img]

• Improved

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/78ec32799aee9797790bc8124dfa41ff00b39128.jpg[/img]

[h3]— FIGHT[/h3]

Leprechaun has the ability "foolhardiness", the attack is increased by receiving damage from the attack of another card. It is summed up.

[b]Advantages:[/b]

The leprechaun has a very large supply of health and its quite low level of attack is compensated by the ability "foolhardiness". Leprechaun will gain its attack rating to 60% while receiving any damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0a23375ab532c71cda3d4a61fe63218406ef4f70.jpg[/img]

[b]Interaction in a battle with other cards:[/b]

Leprechaun is a colorless card that looks quite individual. Having leader cards will help him to increase chances of winning. Good leader cards: forged sentinel and possessed mage. The leader forged sentinel will increase armor and possessed mage will give the power to attack by fire against the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/4eb22014715b6edac3b56fa8dd9d63df3d854d07.jpg[/img]

Be wary of cards that can deprive the Leprechaun of the ability to do magic, such as: Krampus, Mimic, Archivist.

[h3]—Amulets[/h3]

Leprechaun is a very strong creature. We suggest leveling up the card the following way.

[b]King's amulet[/b]

Increases attack, health and attack amplification percentage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b0931c4af978de5287c1858e771a76b825e645be.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of stealth[/b]

Significantly increases the health of the card, but reduces the attack power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/fed66f0daea136e787feec4abe051b28537c2aec.png[/img]

[b]Attack Amulet[/b]

Increases attack power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ab5385336180fae49204af6cedfcc71adab2c833.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of health[/b]

Increases health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a6f8115ee9690aefeb5a0289535fd70a58756388.png[/img]

[h3]— Card color[/h3]

[b]Colorless[/b]

Will give the lack of advantages from the opponents' cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/9936df6452bff09ce44fa4494ad9de0c41b20699.png[/img]

[h3]— Spells[/h3]

[b]Berserk[/b]

Gives additional  power attack and slightly reduces health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/804c50458eb061db5059578c5995428f1d8def12.png[/img]

[b]Maximum Damage[/b]

Can increase the minimum attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0764c43db47d6d3ceff7d4c3b539964db32d19e3.png[/img]

The origin of the Leprechaun remains a mystery for many as well as its untold riches. Everyone knows about his wealth but after meeting with this being nobody became rich.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e8359acece01f9606742499c29bc54b91d871844.jpg[/img]

[h3]Halfling[/h3]

The Battle Pass of March presents new creatures! Read this article to learn more about the new promo card: Halfling.

[h3]Halfling[/h3]

The little folk prefer calm and plentiful life to adventures. Kind, hard-working and thrifty, they are always trying to make their life as comfortable as possible. But one shouldn't underestimate halflings. If their family and home are in danger, they will fight the enemy without hesitation.

[h3]— Skins[/h3]

• Regular

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a44fe8197a1af792bb9bae0b1e85e78d84dff783.jpg[/img]

• Advanced

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/123c6319a2ff20bbeb83ca6fb0ce3af0a5211414.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Battle[/h3]

The Halfling uses the Deliberation ability: if the card is the last to enter a battle, then at the beginning of a duel it increases attack and health according to the ability percentage, removes negative effects and restores the changed color.

[b]Advantages:[/b]

The Halfling has an impressive amount of health, and its ability allows him to increase the basic stats and remove negative effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/984b78acddd63c0e200dddeeb20ed6f5bfd98d46.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle interaction with other cards:[/b]

The Earth Titan will boost the card’s stats, which are already quite good. The Elemental Enhancement ability will increase the basic stats (attack and health) of the Halfling.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e431953e726309107cbae410bea80fd69dec81dd.jpg[/img]

The Kraken can increase the percentage of the Halfling’s ability with the help of the Leader: Control ability. The higher the percentage of the Halfling’s ability, the bigger the increase of his stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/088338b215cff7b247797ae689609484c9d1f621.jpg[/img]

Beware cards that can block the Halfling’s magic, for example, the Krampus or the Mimic. If the Halfling fights against the Mimic at the end of the battle, the latter will deprive him of magic. What’s more, Mimic will immediately use the Deliberation ability to his own advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/98924e62d9a7367f5623702e772e1e0b1a35b7ef.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Amulets[/h3]

The Halfling must be used to finish a battle if you want to get maximum profit from this card. We recommend strengthening the card in the following way.

[b]Amulet of Stealth[/b]

Considerably increases health, but reduces attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/fed66f0daea136e787feec4abe051b28537c2aec.png[/img]

[b]Green Amulet of Life[/b]

Increases health and ability trigger chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/6612dcec01e0c7d33bb98bda208751e7ea29d7fd.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Health[/b]

Increases the card’s health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a6f8115ee9690aefeb5a0289535fd70a58756388.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Attack[/b]

Increases the card’s attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ab5385336180fae49204af6cedfcc71adab2c833.png[/img]

[h3]— Card Colour[/h3]

[b]Green[/b]

Provides advantage over cards of the Red element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e3ccd2c75ac61a4f00e2d957601b6b983b202d0e.png[/img]

[h3]— Spells[/h3]

[b]Talisman[/b]

Helps the card reach its maximum health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0ac1e8e76826bfa4163db4db46fe09c22e70c185.png[/img]

[b]Maximum Damage[/b]

Increases the minimum attack of the card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0764c43db47d6d3ceff7d4c3b539964db32d19e3.png[/img]

[b]Luck[/b]

It’s the most important spell that will considerably increase the boost of stats caused by the Deliberation ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/bd0e20d632a01e5fb364e86243bb19451dd2f30d.png[/img]

You can get the Halfling promo card in the “Landscaping” Battle Pass game mode. Good luck on the battlefields!

notes.title: Abnoba
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/012aaff5da1ccd73d747aca0c680a63f9b5b17a5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Abnoba[/h3]

The epic card Abnoba is the main reward of the Battle Pass in March. Read this article to learn why the goddess of hunting is so dangerous and what prey she prefers.

[h3]Abnoba[/h3]

To come back from hunting - alive and with a plentiful kill - people made offerings to Abnoba, the goddess of hunting. She temporarily granted some of her powers to those worthy of her blessing. Marauders, on the contrary, got cursed, and sometimes even killed by her avatar that had descended into this world.

[h3]— Skins[/h3]

• Regular

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/56699370efbf8599d3357aa8ee07e59ac6b0a95a.jpg[/img]

• Advanced

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0885cff80338309cde0334e237e4ef6143c31341.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Battle[/h3]

Abnoba has the Grove Spirit ability: At the beginning of a duel it increases attack by the ability percentage and reduces the opponent's attack to minimum.

[b]Advantages:[/b]

Abnoba has good attack and health stats, and her ability allows to increase extra physical strength. Besides, Abnoba reduces the opponent’s attack to minimum and thus improves her survivability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/3c3f556733f08c748399dc6a3a7bf2cb0c67161c.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle interaction with other cards:[/b]

Abnoba is a truly formidable enemy. Using her ability, she is quite self-sufficient. The Earth Titan can boost her stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/27bc43717d6dd130ac711d24f689aa693f69f081.jpg[/img]

Leader cards, such as the Werewolf and the Griffin Rider, are good allies for Abnoba. They will improve her survivability.

The Kraken can considerably increase the percentage of Abnoba’s ability, which will give her an extra boost of stats. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/8c172414f1591cf7ad4cc617b83bb855bd627fdf.jpg[/img]

In battle, beware cards that can get an early victory, such as the Carnivorous Toad, the Red Dragon, etc.

Cards that can deprive their opponent of magic can also disrupt Abnoba’s plans — for example, the Krampus or the Mimic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/64f5c8f8a0911ed20113659f21b6bc0c245a7b95.jpg[/img]

[h3]— Amulets[/h3]

Abnoba has a very high potential. As a true goddess of hunting, she can corner and easily kill even a very dangerous creature. We recommend to strengthen the card in the following way:

[b]Amulet of Magic[/b]

Increases the amount of health and the ability trigger chance, but slightly reduces damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c63a056123f9614a3a16331051cac5be043285d1.png[/img]

[b]Green Amulet of Life[/b]

Increases health and ability trigger chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/6612dcec01e0c7d33bb98bda208751e7ea29d7fd.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Attack[/b]

Increases the card’s attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ab5385336180fae49204af6cedfcc71adab2c833.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Health[/b]

Increases the card’s health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a6f8115ee9690aefeb5a0289535fd70a58756388.png[/img]

New promo card — Cupid, the god of love. Read our article to learn what powers he possesses, and why it is dangerous to interfere in his plans.

[h3]Cupid[/h3]

He is a messenger of love,
With bow and quiver on his back.
Women and men, look out above
Or you might have a love attack!

[b]— Skins[/b]

• Regular

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/96d235c516f4e72371cf014aa4b26bf02e78a62e.jpg[/img]

• Advanced

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/de4051df5763d0af91b7d8d16ea32622a13939c4.jpg[/img]

[b]— Battle[/b]

The Cupid has the Lethal Love ability. When attacking, he has a chance of enchanting the opponent and making it lose 100% of maximum health in 2 turns. Titans are immune.

[b]Advantages:[/b]

The Cupid’s attack and health stats aren’t impressive, but his ability allows to easily confront even the most powerful creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e3f30fca8f80d1d4d773e4866566e3226d18504b.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle interaction with other cards:[/b]

The Cupid will benefit from the support of the creatures that can increase his physical stats. The Sun Titan will be an excellent ally for the Cupid.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/9435741604050b6b43e78e74c0d9ac8181e89983.jpg[/img]

The Cupid can defeat powerful enemies only by using his ability. It is absolutely necessary to pay attention to the trigger chance of the Lethal Love ability. The Kraken leader card will help the Cupid achieve his maximum health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/db971323a7d8949b8b1a4b66c33cc3fd82ae092c.jpg[/img]

The Cupid should be used in attack only, but he still can lose if his opponent is a Titan, or if he loses his ability due to the evil spells of the Krampus or the Mimic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ae46b80045dd30c2914e6ef2b2bd0035be5cd95d.jpg[/img]

[b]— Amulets[/b]

It is recommended to increase all stats of the Cupid. You do it with the following amulets:

[b]Amulet of Magic[/b]

Increases the amount of health and the ability trigger chance, but slightly reduces damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c63a056123f9614a3a16331051cac5be043285d1.png[/img]

[b]White Amulet of Defense[/b]

Increases the card’s health

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b79ec888aedb99880b2d6ef48e99b3829b0af080.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Attack[/b]

Increases the card’s attack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ab5385336180fae49204af6cedfcc71adab2c833.png[/img]

[b]Amulet of Luck[/b]

Increases the ability trigger chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a9cf0e99989c629594887ac789bd8523113227af.png[/img]

[b]Card Colour[/b]

[b]White[/b]

Provides advantage over cards of the Black element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/dd95dcedf83396ef180723b11af2506a55cc3d6c.png[/img]

[h3]— Spells[/h3]

[b]Maximum damage[/b]

Increases minimum attack

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0764c43db47d6d3ceff7d4c3b539964db32d19e3.png[/img]

[b]Gift of Gods[/b]

Increases attack and health, removes all negative effects from the card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/4004867cc64935020f0a6c7a76918cc98220dc07.png[/img]

[b]Luck[/b]

Increases the ability trigger chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/bd0e20d632a01e5fb364e86243bb19451dd2f30d.png[/img]

The Cupid will become a good combat unit for many decks. His magic power can force many opponents into a corner, and together with good allies the Cupid can reach his maximum potential.

[h3]1. The start of a new event: Treasures of Titans[/h3]

The Treasures of Titans is a new game event. Players can take part in it and get new valuable rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/2b9acccf7f0459e48ba3bceb323c63db86567a99.png[/img]

The event icon can be found in the castle, in the top right corner.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ec850646b68aeb8ec25e2d486e42c851385b8b19.jpg[/img]

In the game mode window, you will see the progress bar, the number of levels in this mode, and the rewards for each level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/951468d00c058a9f9bbde14a97508d6c0da0b9ba.jpg[/img]

To fill the progress bar, you need special points — VIP points. To earn them and to take part in the Treasures of Titans event, you need to make in-game purchases (Crystals at the shop, Promo offers, Cards).

As soon as you get enough VIP points, a set of rewards is unlocked. After obtaining the reward, you move to the next level, and the amount of VIP points is reset.

[i]Note: if you score more VIP points than required for getting the reward and reaching the next level, you can’t keep the excess of VIP points. When you get the reward, the progress bar is reset, as you start each new level with zero VIP points.

The scored VIP points are also added to the total count of VIP points in the player’s profile.
Levels and rewards

In total, there are 7 levels in the Treasures of Titans event. The higher the level, the more VIP points you need, and the more valuable rewards you get.[/i]
