notes.title: Card Skins
notes.notes:
In Blood of Titans, each card has its own story, uses a special ability, and is visually distinct from other cards. Earlier you learnt how to enhance a card using amulets and special buildings. But there is one more way to improve the card stats — by upgrading its skin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b30fdbe4e26993595d46c670cecce23f15a255de.jpg[/img]

To upgrade a card skin,  one needs to collect all the necessary skin fragments. The number of fragments is different for each card and depends on the card rarity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/91679b725e33131311310f567eb8442572b5f14f.jpg[/img]

Skin fragments can be created with the help of a ritual in a special building — the Skin Altar. This building is available to players on Level 11 and higher.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b543bb99156a1ca43a47820eed247ed244c407bd.jpg[/img]

To start the ritual, one needs gold and illusion gems. The amount of resources required for the ritual depends on your Skin Altar level. The higher the level, the more skin fragments you can get with one ritual, and the more resources it shall take.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0ca8aefb630023ed54abef8fd79b01ea6f97b29f.jpg[/img]

Skin fragments are created randomly. Once the ritual is over, the Skin Altar will display the cards for which the fragments have been created.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/1f929046a19234e55cff1552ddca1e305cd25cee.jpg[/img]

The available fragments are displayed in the card details menu. When you get all the skin fragments that are required for an upgrade, you can activate an enhanced skin and increase the card stats by 20%. Later you can choose any card skin to your liking. The 20% increase of the stats will stay with the card forever. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/85904a0cd027f5cbd5842a6bb6fb019093f2160d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Raids
notes.notes:
After reaching Level 12, players get access to the new game mode: Raids. In this mode, players can fight hordes of absolutely different enemies to get valuable resources. On the map, raids are marked with a special skull icon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c7d70c74c6db6c8954f9224df85e18e1e8b614a8.jpg[/img]

When the players go to the Raids tab, they see the raid name and the number of halls they need to pass to win the main prize — a card. The halls are full of enemies that will attack the players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b474a3b5017d5c1039753df5c9bf1e7d63ed760d.jpg[/img]

This game mode is different from the standard one. The players can see all 5 enemy cards at once and choose 5 cards from their deck to fight those opponents. The winner gets an interim prize: gold, mana, and mithril (a new resource). Mithril is used to open a special chest with epic cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/345831a07afa52b661e7ed064356b23c0c8e45f7.jpg[/img]

The allied cards that lose the battle will "die": you can use them again only after resurrection (paid in crystals) or after nullifying the raid progress. To continue the raid, the player can choose other cards that haven't fought yet and have the "alive" status in the deck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/d926f28f70a66bb6a8f54c7b42ff41f5b047da34.jpg[/img]

The player has to defeat a chain of enemies and move from one hall to another. When the raid chain is completed, you will get a rare or epic card, depending on the raid difficulty. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/b498a3f085e22a80beec11d710a6cb2f25d9eb48.jpg[/img]

After successfully defeating all the enemies in one raid hall, the player goes to the next one, which is more difficult, and repeats the process.

notes.title: Arena
notes.notes:
The battleground isn't the only place where you can upgrade your cards. You can also do it at the Arena — a special training facility in your city. 

All players get access to the Arena after reaching Level 19. It considerably accelerates the upgrade of your cards. You can use the Arena to help weaker cards catch up with the others, or boost your favorites as much as possible! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/efa956a229ee9f6e8ac195ea1944a500924a0ae0.jpg[/img]

On the entry levels you can train your cards only one by one. As you upgrade the building, new training slots will open. All in all, you can simultaneously train 3 cards at the Arena.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/07f2bbd7fccc50254b7631d594f02ddd05232df4.jpg[/img]

The cost and duration of one training session depends on the level of the building, the level of the card, and the amount of experience the card needs for a levelup. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/715b462bd592a23638cc941fa319da6ed2853382.jpg[/img]

Once the training session is over, the card gets the experience it needs for the upgrade, and the wins that increase its rank.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e0d52fd106c9d5d42f38ded16b7b8cf1b0ba0da2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Catacombs
notes.notes:
In the Blood of Titans world, there are many opportunities to challenge other adventurers. Apart from PVP leagues and the Tournament of Mages, players can go to Catacombs — a special game mode where one can raid ancient kings’ crypts and attack other players to get elemental stones.

After reaching Level 14, every mage can send expeditions to the dark dungeons. A squad of fearless creatures will hunt for precious elemental stones and get them back to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/8b09ea993d0317b3237bd3f8c2e5daa5623f0340.jpg[/img]

The higher the level of your Catacombs building is, the deeper its shaft goes, and the more squads can enter it to obtain valuable resources. To send several expeditions at a time, you need to collect a lot of powerful cards. Remember that your squad will face other treasure hunters in the dungeons. The more wins it gets, the more elemental stones it brings back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/eb83b64811317ad25e00c449c2785aff95f66995.jpg[/img]

When your treasure hunters descend to the Catacombs and fill their bags with elemental stones, they become visible to other players who might want to attack. If your expedition defends itself, it keeps the collected treasures, but a defeat means that the enemy takes all the elemental stones. Only a strong squad has good chances to return from the Catacombs with flying colors!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/0cb18df41c535e62105fbb52af6fc9e3da28db19.jpg[/img]

The Catacombs are waiting for new adventurers!  Are you ready to hunt for resources regardless of the dangers?

notes.title: Creating and Developing Your Clan
notes.notes:
The Blood of the Titans world is full of riddles and mysteries, adventures and dangers. To cope with them, you and your friends can join efforts and create a clan.

Clan membership gives you extra in-game bonuses that can be used to develop your city. You can also share resources with other clan members, chat with them and fight together in Clan Wars.

Any player that reaches Level 7 can build the Clanhall. Once erected, it allows you to search for a clan that is currently recruiting members — or to create your own clan and become its leader!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c339a40b0f0889288636380ccd26c9e81315076d.jpg[/img]

[b]Joining an Existing Clan[/b]

Use the “Find a Clan” tab to join a community that matches your level of city development and deck strength. You can also apply for membership in a clan from the Top 100 and immerse in fierce battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/ce493ad7d74ead7d68709375f2fdf358e3f44e35.jpg[/img]

Every clan has a description that includes its special greeting, a set of compulsory rules, and other details. Read descriptions to see which clan's atmosphere and playing style is most suitable for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/23a58cacaca55ad57825fb0b6f5be2055616904e.jpg[/img]

If a certain clan is open to everyone, and there are vacant places, you can push the "Join" button and automatically become a Novice clan member.

[b]Creating Your Own Clan[/b]

If no clan suits you, or if you want to become the leader of your own community, you can create a new clan and take the highest position of the Supreme Mage.

When creating a clan, you need to set up a series of parameters to create a unique guild image. Give your clan a name, create a coat of arms, and write an original description that will attract your future associates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/fee96902a44eec388c76e248a72773ec15703a63.jpg[/img]

[b]Clan Castle[/b]

Once you've created or joined a clan, you get into the Clan Castle that can be accessed only by the members. Every day you have to make contributions in gold to different buildings of the Castle, gradually upgrading them to the maximum level. All in all, there are 16 buildings, and each of them is associated with a title that can be given to any clan member. Once appointed, such a player will automatically give bonuses to all allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/af5a5e0d20cab5862126f4b53cb86a6d93d89c98.jpg[/img]

A new Castle has the minimum set of towers and positions:
[olist]
[*] Supreme Mage — the creator of the clan who has access to clan management and gives titles to other members.
[*] Coin Counselor — the assistant of the Supreme Mage, gives extra gold from Gold Mines to all clan members.
[*] Magic Counselor — the assistant of the Supreme Mage, gives extra mana from Mana Wells to all clan members.
[*] Tower Sentinel — gets a boost of card strength when defending the castle in Clan Wars.
[*] Battle Mages — get a boost of card strength when attacking an enemy castle in Clan Wars.
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/fd6f0755f94894b8f84315512ff735a8b6979791.jpg[/img]

Click on the castle towers to see the detailed information on each title: its bonuses, assigned allies, the number of contributions required for an upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/4afbbe8d163f894553810ea0d95c1598984d1252.jpg[/img]

[b]Клановые битвы[/b]

Каждую неделю  кланы участвуют в особой битве, по итогу которой определяются победители. В зависимости от занятого кланом места, все его участники могут открыть особо ценные сундуки с картами и другими ресурсами!

Для участия в клановой битве потребуется собрать особую колоду для нападения на вражеский замок. Выбранные для нападения существа могут быть легко заменены перед боем, чтобы собрать наиболее эффективную команду против колоды врага.

В зависимости от итогов всей клановой битвы ваш клан будет передвигаться по лигам. За первые места ждёт повышение лиги, а также более сильные противники и наиболее ценные призы. За последние места - понижение лиги, ослабленные кланы-соперники и меньшие награды.

[b]Обмен ресурсами[/b]

Члены клана получают возможность обмена Фрагментами амулетов и Жетонами существ – это ценные ресурсы, необходимые для улучшения амулетов и усиления ваших карт. Любой участник клана может отправить запрос на необходимые ему ресурсы, или выполнить запросы других участников.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e661d29fa0909b9b1bd0ae6071b5a681bfdcacbb.jpg[/img]

[b]Clan Chest[/b]

Only clan members have access to the Clan Chest. Apart from valuable resources, it may give you unique cards that are very useful in battle. They boost allied creatures or weaken enemy cards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/34610945fb83b33d3ec71c129dc87fa1c1930445.jpg[/img]

For many players, their clan is not just a community of people that gives them access to special game modes. A clan is often like a family, and its members meet both online and offline.

notes.title: Leagues: the Path of a Battle Mage
notes.notes:
Every battle mage that has attacked an enemy castle signs up for participation in a league! All in all, there are 10 of them, and new mages begin their way from the Pearl League. Participants of each league divide into small groups where they compete, trying to get as many victories as possible in two days.

There are no specific requirements for participation: you will score points by defeating enemy mages in your usual battles and get a rank in the league table. The first three leaders with the maximum number of victories move to the next league, and so on — up to the final Onyx League.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/6254f5fee2b437becd86e4f3c9f99b2ee142dbb2.jpg[/img]

You will get an award for competing in a league: a certain number of gold keys depending on your rank in the league table and the level of the league itself. The higher the league, the more keys you will get for your efforts.

The winners of the fifth Diamond League and the tenth Onyx League will get unique promo cards — the furious Succubus and the merciless Many-Faced Demon! You can only move upwards in the leagues, and your rank won’t go down if you lose or skip a battle. We wish you rapid growth and easy victories!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/f4dd1c8066dfd609b4114402e26b5d560aef43e9.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Attacking Enemy Castles
notes.notes:
Right from the very beginning of your reign in the Realm, you can attack other players. It’s a surefire way to announce yourself and declare your intention to build a prosperous castle — and it also allows you to collect resources for building. 

The outcome of such an attack depends largely on your battle deck, which consists of ten creatures belonging to different elements, rarity, and type. Each card has an indicator of its strength, and the sum of those indicators forms the total strength of the deck. This parameter helps to find opponents who are more or less your match so that you’ll fight on equal grounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c646f59cd751b2e19b6313985620977a8a0a9cc3.jpg[/img]

The search for an opponent costs 5 drops of blood. After the payment, you get to the enemy castle and see the list of resources you’ll gain after the victory. To avoid unpleasant surprises, you can take a peep at the opponent’s deck and replace some of your creatures if need be. Let the battle begin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c64efcc7bc30946b3430c597c5e59bb8c44b739f.jpg[/img]

Only 5 creatures from your deck take part in the battle, and the first turn is awarded randomly. After that, players take turns to choose a creature for the duel: in attack, you are the first to play a card, and in defence, you choose the creature to oppose the attacker. With each victory in a duel, you score a point. To win in a battle, you need to prevail in at least 3 duels out of 5.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/c76dc88782abe4ebb271880c189ec04b64087f99.jpg[/img]

To increase your chances of winning, use spell scrolls to strengthen your allies or weaken your opponent’s creatures. Sometimes spells drastically change the battle outcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/8c3f15aec9c91ca0d7bc81e0e81b41383a71264f.jpg[/img]

If you win a battle, your ranking points increase, and an epic 5-star win brings you an extra prize! The defeat results in losing points. 

Every victory brings you honor and glory, moving you up on the ranking table. Good luck on the battleground!

notes.title: Amulets
notes.notes:
We’ve already mentioned the mysterious amulets that improve the attributes of your creatures, and now it’s time to tell you more about them!

In total, there are 19 amulets in the Magic Lands. They can be divided into 4 types: amulets of attack, amulets of defense, amulets of support, and creature amulets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/22278ce72284b1e7512e07ac8594fd947e65b5f1.jpg[/img]

Every creature card has 4 slots. If all of them are open, you can fill the slots with 4 amulets (1 of each type). Different combinations of amulets allow you to fine-tune the card attributes: to make your creature more enduring, to increase the damage it deals to enemies, or to boost its special ability. You can always remove the amulets from the card and try other combinations until you finally get the desired stats.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/64dce22b6e463d22239885ca9ab1e5c6db52512d.jpg[/img]

Such amulets as the Amulet of Attack, the Amulet of Luck, the Amulet of Health, and the Amulet of Defense can be used for creatures of all types and elements. But each creature type can carry only one creature amulet, and elemental amulets can be used only by cards of the corresponding element.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/58e2c287663d935f4798cb3ecb1beb159348d336.jpg[/img]

You can make extra improvements to each amulet with the help of elemental stones and creature tokens — the new level of the amulet will provide an additional boost to the card. However, creature tokens must match the type of the creature that will use the improved amulet, and the color of elemental stones must match the color of the card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/45ed86d5da36248e45deb4a7d3f987d024c0e613.jpg[/img]

The creature with a full combination of amulets becomes a much better version of itself. A deck of such creatures can withstand even the most invincible enemies. It’s time to fight and win!

notes.title: Summoning Portal
notes.notes:
The magic lands abound with various beings that have been classified as follows: Humans, Animals, Undead, Magical, Monsters, Draconids, and Titans. All creatures have a certain level of rarity, which indicates the difficulty of obtaining such a card, and also the power of its attributes: Common (the weakest ones), Uncommon, Rare, Epic, and Legendary (powerful creatures indeed).

You may be lucky enough to encounter some creatures when following quest stories, get them as a prize for winning the Tournament of Mages, or, if Fortune favors you, find them in certain valuable chests. But mostly you will have to perform rituals in the Summoning Portal to add new creatures to your deck.

To perform such a ritual, you will need a combination of three Shards — you can obtain them in quest battles or steal from other battle mages if their summoning ritual is active. Just like creatures, shards have a certain rarity level from Common to Legendary. The higher the rarity of shards in your combination, the better you chance to summon a creature of higher rarity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/949d7cb76f98003811296e8d524e289d7f05e0a1.jpg[/img]

The creatures of Common and Uncommon rarity are the easiest to summon, but even in this case the ritual can fail, and instead of a card you will get a shard of the same or higher rarity. When you have summoned enough creatures, your Portal can produce duplicates of the cards you already have in your deck. They will be diffused into crystals.

You need some time to perform the ritual. During this period your castle is vulnerable to the attacks of other mages. If your defense forces are vanquished, the enemy troop will get a chance to steal one of the shards loaded into the Portal. In this case, your ritual will be suspended until you return to the Realm. You can take revenge on the assailant and take the shard back, or use a new shard to resume the ritual.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a71a1b6040bb67f14ca2a354491e2a9dd71d6b34.jpg[/img]

Useful tip: use the shards of the maximum available rarity to increase your chances to summon rarer creatures! Good luck with your rituals!

notes.title: How to Improve the Attributes of Your Cards
notes.notes:
Your deck is a collection of unique creatures united under your banner. They attack enemy castles, bringing valuable resources, and glorious victories to your Kingdom! 
 
As your Castle grows and develops, more and more creatures will join you. Strong creatures will replace weak ones, ordinary cards will give way to rare ones. If you want your creatures to be more effective in battle, you need to improve them regularly. 
 
Every creature can be boosted with the help of amulets inserted into card slots (up to 4 in total). Amulet bonuses can be combined, and together they influence the three main attributes of a creature: endurance (health), damage (attack), and its chance to successfully use the special ability (ability chance). Each amulet has improvement levels that provide additional bonuses. Different combinations of amulets allow you to emphasize a specific attribute of a creature — for example, to make a card much more enduring. You can also remove amulets from a card and create new combinations at any moment of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/19b2ff4ca2df2553d4cfec55628d89567bded73a.jpg[/img]
 
The more victories a creature scores during its time in the battle deck, the higher its experience and rank. Starting from the first rank and going up to the fifth one, a creature gets better attributes with every new rank (and with every evolution level as well). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/1aba40fac9e1e30f7b6bd8f985115fb8db04b9dc.jpg[/img]
 
Military buildings in your Castle also influence the battle power of your creatures, but they can get damaged because of frequent use and require repair. Fix them on time, and it will give additional attack and health bonuses to all allied cards in battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/8a3573db294b407985aa5c42913c772004839070.jpg[/img]
 
Add those bonuses in advance, and your deck will have better attributes when going to battle against your enemies. You can also use spells that affect the attributes of allied or hostile decks during one battle. The use of spells can drastically change the battle outcome and bring you victory! 
 
The balanced use of deck-boosting tools will open new opportunities to your troop of creatures — the best prizes in quests, the best leagues, and the best rankings in tournaments!

notes.title: Obelisks and Storehouses
notes.notes:
Your castle is the heart of the game. With every level you get access to more buildings, unique monuments, magic edifices, and military facilities. Some of the buildings strengthen your deck of creatures, others increase the supplies of resources. Today we are going to talk about the latter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/e16c38e0dd4cc380e935492bfe98448cb96103ea.jpg[/img]

The main resources for erecting new buildings are gold and mana, which are generated by the Gold Mine and the Mana Well respectively. In the town, there can be several buildings that produce basic resources. Realm development requires investments, be that repair of military facilities, purchase or creation of spells, your contribution to clan development, etc.

Apart from the basic resources (gold and mana), there are also unique resources in Magic Lands: creature tokens, amulets, element stones, gems, and soul shards. To replenish your supplies of these resources, you will have to fight other players and complete quests. But some buildings in your Realm are resource obelisks that can produce valuable stones on their own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/a2a69c9f17990efa098653b22f249f7a4904fa06.jpg[/img]

To protect your supplies from other battle mages, you can keep them in special storehouses — each of those buildings is responsible for one resource and safeguards it against invaders. The surplus resources outside your storehouses are exposed to plunder should someone attack the town.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/212af24407e6b18a415dcc60f334909e4353b427.jpg[/img]

To avoid plunder, you can cast a shield onto your town, and enemies won’t be able to attack it. But the best strategy for Realm development is the active use of valuable resources. We wish your lands prosperity and victories!

notes.title: Gems of Illusion
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We’re going to let you in on a secret: how to make your beings even stronger! Just simply use gems of illusion on the Altar of Illusions. Attack enemy castles and collect gems from the mine in your city. With a sufficient amount of resources, the ritual on the Altar of Illusions will become available to you. During the ritual, your gems will turn into fragments of illusions of beings that are in your deck. The higher the rarity of the being, the more fragments of illusions you will need to collect to get a single illusion! 

The new image of the being gives additional health and increases the attack, as well as updates the appearance of the card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/73795f67de2d8827604710ec2b3fcc1535842219.jpg[/img]

However, save your gems! To do this, you can build a Gem Storage building in the city and some of the resources will help to hide the Citadel. Other battle mages are capable of stealing surplus valuable gems, so improve the building's capacity in time and perform more rituals. 

We wish you success and prosperity!

notes.title: Collection of beings
notes.notes:
All beings inhabiting magic lands can become your allies. To get this or that card in your deck, you will need to go down dungeons, fight in tournaments, perform summoning rituals and go through quest chains. 

Each being belongs to one of the type (Human, Undead, Titan, Drakonid, Monster etc.), has such a rarity as common, uncommon, rare or epic and also each being has its magic ability that gives an advantage over rivals in battles. Winning battles, your Cards receive experience and become stronger. 

The Card gets additional benefits to its characteristic on the basis of different amulets that you choose. In total, you can insert up to 4 different amulets into the card, which can significantly impact on the fighting abilities of the beings: make it a powerful magician, an uncrushable tank or a smart killer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39092252/3e3786c27d7c938c40d5c37bfad775a9b16fbb8a.jpg[/img]

The rarity of a being depends on its strength, ability and difficulty to receive it. It is easy to get Common, Uncommon and some Rare cards in your deck. But for Epic and Unique promo cards you need to fight in the tournament of Mages with other players. Legendary beings can be obtained through hard work and these cards significantly enhance your deck in the battle. 
Performing rituals with the Altar of Images, you can create an updated look for your beings, thanks to which strength and health of a card will receive a bonus enhancement. All this will make your deck unique! Fight for new monsters and dragons regularly and use all the opportunities for beings to grow. Good luck with the game!

notes.notes:
Hey Guys,
We are glad to announce a launch of our official community [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451230/Blood_of_Titans/][b]Blood of Titans[/b][/url]. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1451230/Blood_of_Titans/][b]Blood of Titans[/b][/url] is a free-to-play collectible card game with a non-linear fantasy storyline, PVP and PVE battles, clans, tournaments, unique cards and especial deck builds.
